correctness.rationale: Operators D,B,E,F act on all upsets with the four explicitly quantified clauses. In a height-at-most-two antisymmetric order every world is minimal or maximal: if target v maximal use the singleton upset {v}, and D on minimal source or E on maximal source reads whether sRv; if target v minimal, use W\{v} and complement F/B respectively. Thus all individual edges are reconstructed for arbitrary finite or infinite W. If preorder has equivalent distinct targets a,b, replacing a by b in one relation row preserves every upset intersection/containment test and hence all operators. If strict chain a<b<c, replacing row {a,c} by {a,b,c} likewise preserves these row tests and all operators. The four explicit relation-pair witnesses on a two-element chain are indistinguishable after removing D, B, E or F respectively; independent evaluation of the three possible upsets verified each. The source checker enumerates 1–3 worlds and a 4-world branching poset, but the general proof uses the direct recovery/obstruction arguments, not finite extrapolation.
